mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_search_sync_task( shop_id,version,status,attempt_count,next_retry_at,locked_at,last_error,created_at,updated_at ) VALUES( #{shopId},1,0,0,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,NULL,'',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version=version+1, status=0, attempt_count=0, next_retry_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, locked_at=NULL, last_error='', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT shop_id,version,status,attempt_count,next_retry_at,locked_at,last_error FROM shop_search_sync_task WHERE (status=0 AND next_retry_at<=#{now}) OR (status=1 AND (locked_at IS NULL OR locked_at<=#{staleBefore})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status=0 THEN next_retry_at ELSE locked_at END ASC, shop_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shop_search_sync_task WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND version=#{version} AND status=1
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_search_sync_task SET status=0, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt}, locked_at=NULL, last_error=#{lastError}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND version=#{version} AND status=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS processing_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status=0 AND t.attempt_count>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS retrying_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status=1 AND (t.locked_at IS NULL OR t.locked_at<=#{staleBefore}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS stale_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status=0 AND t.next_retry_at<=#{now} THEN 1 WHEN t.status=1 AND (t.locked_at IS NULL OR t.locked_at<=#{staleBefore}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS ready_count FROM shop_search_sync_task t INNER JOIN shop s ON s.id=t.shop_id WHERE s.region=#{region}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM shop_search_sync_task t INNER JOIN shop s ON s.id=t.shop_id

SELECT t.shop_id, s.name AS shop_name, s.region, c.name AS city_name, t.version, t.status, t.attempt_count, t.next_retry_at, t.locked_at, t.last_error, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM shop_search_sync_task t INNER JOIN shop s ON s.id=t.shop_id LEFT JOIN city c ON c.id=s.city_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status=1 AND (t.locked_at IS NULL OR t.locked_at<=#{staleBefore}) THEN 0 WHEN t.status=0 AND t.attempt_count>0 THEN 1 WHEN t.status=0 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ASC, t.updated_at DESC, t.shop_id ASC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
mapper.update:
UPDATE shop_search_sync_task t SET status=0, next_retry_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, locked_at=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE t.shop_id=#{shopId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop s WHERE s.id=t.shop_id AND s.region=#{region}
)

UPDATE shop_search_sync_task t SET status=0, next_retry_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, locked_at=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ( (t.status=0 AND t.attempt_count>0) OR (t.status=1 AND (t.locked_at IS NULL OR t.locked_at<=#{staleBefore})) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop s WHERE s.id=t.shop_id AND s.region=#{region}
)
